diffs.diff: chip ID register 0x20: part 16400, datasheet reading 64
diffs.evidence: DS20005426G section 5.3.4 / Register 5-12 (p.41): 'The Device ID (Identification) and Revision ID register is a 16-bit read-only register... The upper 8 bits indicate the Device ID of 0x40 for the MCP9600/L00/RL00... The initial release is indicated by a major revision of 1 and a minor revision of 0 or 0x4010 for the MCP9600/L00/RL00'. Bits 15-8 = 0x40, bits 7-0 = 0x10. The model simulates a 16-bit register (regWidth 16) so 0x4010 = 16400 is the full register value; the second reading's 64 (0x40) is only the upper Device ID byte. The driver checks only the upper byte (0x40/0x41), so it also works on later silicon revisions.
